purpose: Comparator records for NYSC COURSE-059 Non-Liner Video Editing With Digital 3D Animation. The governed catalogue publishes no module headings for this course, so the records are shown without a competency matrix. Records describe documented curriculum only and do not establish equivalence, quality or labour demand.
